solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Retire and do something artistic

parts.note: 'with' can stand for 'and', as in bread with butter
to draw is to make a picture, an artistic activity

explanation.surface: A retiree takes up sketching or painting as a pastime.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull back or leave a position is a synonym of retire, as troops do from a field.

clue.text: Easily damaged in a number of days, so to speak

indicators.note: 'so to speak' asks for the word as spoken, giving a word that sounds alike

parts.note: a week is a period of seven days

explanation.surface: Something fragile breaks within a few days of purchase.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeble or fragile things lack strength, so they are easily damaged.

clue.text: Smacking bottom of delinquent — a cheat

indicators.note: in a down clue the bottom of a word is its final letter

parts.note: a sting is a confidence trick, a cheat

explanation.surface: A young offender gets a spanking from a swindler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smacking' is not a spanking here but 'smacking of', having a flavour of.
explanation.definitionFit: Something smacking of garlic is tasting of it: both mean having a particular flavour.

clue.text: No greedy man could be paid this for taking risks

indicators.note: says these letters could be rearranged to form something else

explanation.surface: A selfless person is the opposite of one paid a bonus for hazardous work.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of NO GREEDY MAN gives the answer, and the rest of the clue describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Extra pay given to workers for hazardous duties is what this phrase means.

clue.text: Spooks chap planted in South Africa after uprising

indicators.note: one piece is set down inside the other like a seedling in soil
in a down clue an uprising reads the letters upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a gent is a gentleman, a chap

explanation.surface: Spies send a man undercover in South Africa after a revolt.
explanation.definitionFit: Spooks is slang for spies, and secret agents are spies.

clue.text: Nothing reversing European policy

indicators.note: says the word for nothing is read from right to left

parts.note: nil means nothing, zero

explanation.surface: A political party does a U-turn and has no European policy at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A party line is its official policy or stance.

clue.text: Best possible plan given large support

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece sits beneath the first and so supports it

parts.note: an idea is a plan or scheme
L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: The finest scheme is the one with strong backing.
explanation.definitionFit: Perfect, or the best that could be hoped for, is the adjective's sense.

clue.text: Attempt — first one producing a piece of writing

definitions.text: one producing a piece of writing

parts.note: an essay is an attempt or try
first is written 1ST, and 1 looks like the letter I

explanation.surface: A first try at a written composition.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer of short prose compositions is the one who produces them.

clue.text: Serious crime clergyman initially ignored

indicators.note: says the first letter of the word for clergyman is dropped

parts.note: a parson is a parish priest, a clergyman

explanation.surface: A grave offence by a vicar is overlooked at first.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberately setting fire to property is a serious criminal offence.

clue.text: Tiresomely long, missing objective

parts.note: an end is an aim or objective
'less' means minus or missing, as in a price less tax

explanation.surface: A tedious, drawn-out affair with no clear goal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something seemingly without limit, interminable, is tiresomely long.

clue.text: Profession I wrongly associated with Lorca and Dante

indicators.note: these letters are put together in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Someone mistakenly lumps their profession with two great poets, Lorca and Dante.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Profession' looks like a career, but here it is an avowal, as in a profession of faith.
explanation.definitionFit: A profession of love is an open statement of it, a formal announcement.

clue.text: All nice and tidy when arranged in the same way

indicators.note: these letters are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: Everything looks neat when laid out uniformly.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing things alike, exactly the same each time, is acting in the same way.

clue.text: A half-hearted founder of religion with bishop — one in emirate

indicators.note: the doubled middle letter of the founder's name loses one of its pair, half of its heart

parts.note: the Buddha founded Buddhism
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A lukewarm religious founder and a bishop meet in a Gulf state.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the capital and largest of the seven United Arab Emirates.

clue.text: Union crime involving major and girl

parts.note: big means major or important
Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: An illicit marriage implicates an army major and a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Major' looks like an army rank but is an adjective meaning big.
explanation.definitionFit: Marrying while already married is a crime against the union of marriage.

clue.text: Where students are affected by American

parts.note: camp means theatrically affected or exaggerated

explanation.surface: Students are influenced by an American lecturer.
explanation.definitionFit: The grounds of a university or college are where its students live and study.

clue.text: Be victorious before beginning of violence and trouble

parts.note: pre- is a prefix meaning before

indicators.note: takes only the opening letter of the following word

parts.note: to ail is to trouble or afflict

explanation.surface: Winning before violence and trouble break out.
explanation.definitionFit: To win through or triumph is to be victorious.

clue.text: Way a clock face appears mostly in sports arenas

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

indicators.note: says most of the word is used, its last letter dropped

parts.note: a dial is the face of a clock

explanation.surface: A clock face is a common sight inside sports grounds.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Latin-style plural of stadium, a sports arena.

clue.text: Show evil spirit, say, overwhelming queen

parts.note: a demon is an evil spirit

indicators.note: the word for say swamps and surrounds the queen's letter

parts.note: to state is to say
R stands for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A malign spirit says something that overpowers a queen.
explanation.definitionFit: To prove or display something is to show it.

clue.text: For instance, memory that's upset Homer's partner

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so read backwards

parts.note: EG is the abbreviation for exempli gratia, for instance
RAM is random access memory in a computer

explanation.surface: A painful memory distresses Homer's wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Homer' suggests the Greek poet, but it is Homer Simpson of the cartoon The Simpsons.
explanation.definitionFit: Marge Simpson is the wife of Homer in the cartoon series.

clue.text: Starts off vaguely in very arduous oral examination

indicators.note: takes the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A student begins hesitantly in a gruelling spoken exam.
explanation.definitionFit: A viva voce is a spoken exam, such as the defence of a doctoral thesis.

clue.text: Ordered a sudden surprise attack over the radio?

indicators.note: on the radio words are only heard, so a word that sounds like these is wanted

parts.note: a raid is a sudden surprise attack

explanation.surface: A command for a surprise assault is given on the airwaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Set out in order, marshalled, as troops are in ranks.

clue.text: Current artist with question, one from part of the Middle-East

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A painter of today with a question for someone from the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: Iraq is a country in the Middle East, and this adjective means from there.

clue.text: Couple from island encountered on the way back

indicators.note: says the word for encountered runs backwards

parts.note: met means encountered

explanation.surface: A pair from an island bump into each other while returning.
explanation.definitionFit: An established romantic pair is called an item in colloquial usage.

clue.text: Odd man with a log hugging one tree in the shade

indicators.note: the scrambled letters wrap round and embrace the other piece
odd suggests these letters are in an odd, irregular order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A strange man with a log sits beneath a tree in the shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Odd' rearranges MAN and A LOG, and 'hugging' puts I inside them. 'In the shade' adds that the word is also a creamy paint colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A flowering tree with large showy blooms, whose name is also a pale cream colour.
